prompt:
You match supplier price-list items to a product catalog.
Decide which catalog candidate, if any, is exactly the same product as the price-list item.
How to decide:
1. Find the model number (letters and digits, e.g. PSLX350H or MDR-J10) in the price-list item.
2. A candidate with the same model number is the same product, ignoring case, dashes and spaces,
   and ignoring a colour or variant suffix such as /BLUE or BK/WH on an otherwise identical base
   model. Different wording, descriptions or prices do not matter.
3. If no candidate shares the model number, pick one only when brand and product type are the
   same and the names share distinctive words. Otherwise answer "none".
4. Never answer "none" only because the wording or the price differs.
Confidence: 0.9 or more when the model number matches; 0.6 to 0.8 when brand and product type
match but no model number can be compared; below 0.5 when you are unsure.
Answer with one JSON object and nothing else. Write "reason" first: one sentence that
compares the model numbers of the item and the best candidate. Then decide.
{"reason": "<comparison>", "choice": <number 1..N or "none">, "confidence": <0.0..1.0>}

Price-list item:
name: Brenthaven Sling II Titanium Laptop Carrying Bag For 15' MacBook Pro - TR654ZMA; brand: brenthaven; description: Brenthaven Sling II Titanium Laptop Carrying Bag For 15' MacBook Pro - TR654ZMA/ Lightweight And Durable Protective Case/ Rugged Ballistic Nylon/ Custom Fit Padded Computer Compartment/ External Pocket/ Side Water Bottle Pocket/ Ergonomic Strap With Tuck Away Option/ Internal Accessory Panel/ Fits M...

Candidates:
1. name: SLING II LAPTOP CASE - 21 INCH - 4.5 INCH - 14.5 INCH - 2221; brand: Brenthaven; check: no model number to compare, brand equal
2. name: Speck Products SeeThru Case for Apple 15' MacBook Pro - MB15-CLR-SEE-V2; brand: Speck Products; description: Plastic - Clear; check: model numbers differ, brand differs
3. name: Apple MacBook Pro Notebook - MB471LL/A; brand: Apple; description: Intel Core 2 Duo 2.53GHz - 15.4' WXGA+ - 4GB DDR3 SDRAM - 320GB HDD - DVD-Writer (DVDR/RW) - Gigabit Ethernet, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth - Mac OS X 10.5 Leopard; price: $2,369.00; check: model numbers differ, brand differs

response.text: {"reason": "The price-list item has model number TR654ZMA which does not match any candidate's model number, and the brand and product type do not match the second and third candidates.", "choice": "none", "confidence": 0.2}
